title: Thick subcategory
statement: A full subcategory of a triangulated category is thick if it contains $0$, is closed under isomorphisms, shifts in both directions, and cones (if two vertices of a distinguished triangle lie in it, so does the third), and under direct summands. The thick subcategory generated by a class $\mathscr S$ of objects is the intersection of all thick subcategories containing $\mathscr S$.

mathlib_match.how: One clause per declaration, specializing from pretriangulated to triangulated categories. A thick full subcategory with object property P is the conjunction P.IsTriangulated and P.IsStableUnderRetracts: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.IsTriangulated at Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Triangulated/Subcategory.lean:182 contains zero, all integer shifts and extensions; its instances at :185 and :189 and ext_of_isTriangulatedClosed₁/:123, ext_of_isTriangulatedClosed₂/:129, ext_of_isTriangulatedClosed₃/:135 give all three two-out-of-three cases. CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.IsStableUnderRetracts at Mathlib/CategoryTheory/ObjectProperty/Retract.lean:33 gives direct-summand closure (a retract is given by inclusion and projection with composite identity); its IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms instance at :51 gives strict fullness. CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.prop_zero at Mathlib/CategoryTheory/ObjectProperty/ContainsZero.lean:57 gives the chosen zero object. For an arbitrary generating class S use CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.triangEnvelope at Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Triangulated/Generators.lean:132, specialized to (S ⊔ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero). The zero seed guarantees Nonempty by ContainsZero.lean:64, :48 and CompleteLattice.lean:38, so the envelope is triangulated by Generators.lean:177, stable under retracts by :152 and contains S by le_triangEnvelope at :140. Its equality with the intersection in the item is the one-line universal-property specialization triangEnvelope_le_iff at :179 to this seed: a thick Q contains S ⊔ IsZero iff it contains S, since Q contains every zero object by ObjectProperty.prop_of_isZero at ContainsZero.lean:51. This includes empty S; no assumption that S is nonempty, no idempotent-completeness assumption and no extra coefficient hypotheses are imposed.
